description: Ten unprotected ADTS frames whose headers declare four raw data blocks each (number_of_raw_data_blocks_in_frame 3), each holding one channel pair block: the samples are counted for the block it holds.
findings: 10 ADTS frames hold fewer raw data blocks than their headers declare

skip.ffprobe: ffmpeg's parser counts the declared blocks and decodes one.
skip.faad: faad2 reads one raw data block per ADTS frame.
skip.faad_trace: faad2 reads one raw data block per ADTS frame.
skip.decode: ffmpeg decodes one block of a frame that declares four.
